capabilities: Render any markdown table as a sortable, filterable database view
Edit cells in place via Alt+Click and drag Kanban cards between lanes
Switch per-table views among Table, Kanban, Gallery, and Calendar layouts
Infer column types from table content or an explicit schema annotation row
Add formula columns that reference other columns by name
disambiguation: Works on existing markdown tables annotated with HTML comments, not a separate database file or query language.
extras: Reading View only; Live Preview support is not yet available. Works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Markdown tables in Obsidian are static text; there is no built-in way to sort, filter, or edit them as structured data without converting to a different format.
summary: Renders markdown tables as interactive database views with typed columns, sorting, filtering, Kanban/Gallery/Calendar layouts, and inline editing.
